 BTS kicks off Asia-Australia tour with 26 shows in 9 cities
 Yonhap News Agency / 2026-11-19 11:30:50 
 Add to Preferred Sources 
 K-pop supergroup BTS is seen in this photo provided by BigHit Music. (PHOTO NOT FOR SALE) (Yonhap) 
 SEOUL, Nov. 19 (Yonhap) -- K-pop supergroup BTS will kick off its Asia-Australia tour in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, on Thursday, with a total of 26 concerts scheduled across nine cities, its agency said.
 According to BigHit Music, the group will begin its "ARIRANG" world tour with concerts at Kaohsiung National Stadium on Wednesday and Nov. 21-22. BTS will then perform 21 shows across seven Asian cities, including Bangkok, Kuala Lumpur, Singapore, Jakarta, Hong Kong and Bulacan in the Philippines.
 In February next year, the group will hold five concerts in two Australian cities, Melbourne and Sydney.
 Ahead of the concerts, the city of Kaohsiung has installed purple lighting, the signature color of BTS, at major landmarks, including the Love River, Dagang Bridge and Kaohsiung Music Center.
 The city's iconic 85 Sky Tower has also staged a special light show, projecting welcome messages onto its exterior. A musical fountain show will be held along the Love River during the concert period.
 Tourism programs have also been arranged, including shuttle buses branded as "Bus 613," named after BTS' debut date of June 13, as well as discounts at night markets and local shops.
 The group's second concert in Kaohsiung on Nov. 21 and its third show in Jakarta on Dec. 29 will be broadcast in cinemas in more than 80 countries and regions worldwide.
